evidence_boundary: H4 local numbers are synthetic/reference mechanism tests, not FRANK prevalence, target-Qwen behavior or production-security estimates. Judge0 independently replicates only one constructed namespace condition.

experiments.interpretation: In an adversarial aliasing construction, surface-token equality is a poor authority identity. Explicit semantic-class/resource identity blocks the constructed cross-class substitution; missing witnesses trigger broad fallback. This is not a Clay-token collision estimate.

Typed semantic firebreaks do not eliminate cognitive-state propagation; in this construction they primarily contain privilege/effect escalation. The result is partly by policy construction and is a falsifier-generating mechanism test, not proof of production security.

setup.fallback: broaden/fail-closed whenever any required witness is missing

experiments.typed_unsafe_accepts: 0 by construction because missing required witnesses always escalate
experiments.interpretation: Selective semantic firebreaks have a strong coverage economics curve. High coverage makes a narrow typed fast path cheap; incomplete coverage buys broader validation rather than optimistic execution.

setup.comparison: integer identity vs compact tuple(class,id,epoch) vs verbose dict/string fields

experiments.interpretation: In CPython, explicit semantic metadata has measurable cost, but a compact tuple costs about half the verbose dict representation in this microbenchmark. This motivates packed/interned handles; it does not estimate Rust/C/Android or FRANK end-to-end latency.
Independent runtime confirms the constructed alias mechanism direction for one condition; it does not make the workload realistic.

experiments.result: Both the untyped memory form and the FACT/TEXT typed form returned all eight requested ground-truth values in the observed Groq llama-3.1-8b-instant outputs.
experiments.interpretation: This simple obvious-injection corpus does not discriminate typed from untyped representations. It is negative evidence against claiming that textual FACT/TEXT tags alone establish the H4 security benefit; stronger multi-stage selector/authority/materialization tests are required.
experiments.ancestry_boundary: Concurrent FRANK C6 sibling experiment; not independent replication of H4.
